projectDesc.p: The Online Critical Pseudepigrapha (OCP) provides digital critical editions of Jewish and Christian pseudepigrapha with a dynamic, base-text invariant multi-witness apparatus.

editorialDecl.p: Encoded using the TEI P5 textcrit module (Parallel Segmentation method). Variants and witness transcriptions are recorded using <app>, <lem>, and <rdg> elements.

app.lem: Initium verborum Esdrae priusquam assumeretur: et dixi, Domine, qui inhabitas saeculum, cuius oculi elevati in superna et aëre,
app.rdg: The beginning of the words of Ezra, before he was taken up. And I said: O Lord, who inhabitest eternity, whose eyes are exalted toward the heights and the air,

app.lem: et cuius thronus inaestimabilis, et gloria incomprehensibilis, cui astat exercitus angelorum cum tremore,
app.rdg: and whose throne is beyond estimation, and whose glory is incomprehensible, before whom the host of angels stands with trembling,

app.lem: quorum servatio in vento et igni convertitur; cuius verbum verum, et dicta perseverantia;
app.rdg: whose service is turned into wind and fire; whose word is true, and whose sayings endure;

app.lem: cuius iussio fortis, et dispositio terribilis; cuius aspectus arefacit abyssos, et indignatio tabescere facit montes, et veritas testificatur:
app.rdg: whose command is strong, and whose ordinance is fearful; whose look drieth up the depths, and whose indignation maketh the mountains to melt, and whose truth beareth witness:

app.lem: exaudi orationem servi tui, et auribus percipe precationem figmenti tui.
app.rdg: hearken unto the prayer of thy servant, and give ear to the supplication of thy creature.

app.lem: Dum enim vivo, loquar, et dum sapio, respondebo.
app.rdg: For while I live I will speak, and while I have understanding I will answer.

app.lem: Nec respicias populi tui delicta, sed qui tibi in veritate serviunt.
app.rdg: O look not upon the sins of thy people, but on those who serve thee in truth.

app.lem: Nec intendas impia gentium studia, sed qui tua testimonia cum doloribus custodierunt.
app.rdg: Regard not the impious endeavors of the heathen, but of those who have kept thy testimonies with afflictions.

app.lem: Nec cogites qui in conspectu tuo false conversati sunt, sed memorare qui ex voluntate tua timorem cognoverunt.
app.rdg: Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before thee, but remember those who according to thy will have acknowledged thy fear.

app.lem: Neque volueris perdere qui pecudum mores habuerunt, sed respicias eos qui legem tuam splendide docuerunt.
app.rdg: Desire not to destroy those that have lived like beasts, but look upon those who have clearly taught thy law.

app.lem: Nec indigneris eis qui bestiis peiores iudicati sunt, sed diligas eos qui semper in tua iustitia et gloria confidunt.
app.rdg: Take not indignation at those who are deemed worse than beasts, but love those who always put their trust in thy righteousness and glory.

app.lem: Quoniam nos et patres nostri talibus languoribus morimur; tu autem propter nos peccatores misericors vocaberis.
app.rdg: For we and our fathers have languished through such diseases; but because of us sinners thou shalt be called merciful.

app.lem: Si enim desideraveris nobis misereri, tunc misericors vocaberis, nobis non habentibus opera iustitiae.
app.rdg: For if thou hast a desire to have mercy upon us, then shalt thou be called merciful, unto us, namely, who have no works of righteousness.

app.lem: Iusti enim, quibus sunt opera multa reposita, ex propriis operibus recipient mercedem.
app.rdg: For the righteous, who have many works laid up with thee, shall out of their own deeds receive reward.

app.lem: Quid enim est homo, ut ei indigneris? vel genus corruptibile, ut ita amariceris de eo?
app.rdg: For what is man, that thou shouldest take displeasure at him? or what is a corruptible race, that thou shouldest be so bitter toward it?

app.lem: In veritate enim nemo est de genitis qui non impie fecerit, et de confitentibus qui non deliquerit.
app.rdg: For in truth there is none among those born who hath not done wickedly, and among those who confess thee none who hath not transgressed.

app.lem: In hoc enim praedicabitur iustitia tua et bonitas tua, Domine, cum misertus fueris his qui non habent substantiam bonorum operum.
app.rdg: For in this thy righteousness and thy goodness shall be declared, O Lord, when thou art merciful unto those who have no substance of good works.
